description: Land Acquisition - Uppuveli, Town & Gravets D/S Division, Trincomalee District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular land parcel (described with detailed boundaries and extent) is needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content focuses entirely on land matters - acquisition, property description, and boundaries - which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the land acquisition declaration rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
